messages:
carla: Heads-up — PR #31245 (schema change + kv-cache tweak) is green locally but CI is throttled. Can we put a hold on merging until we get a short canary slot around 16:00 PST? Need approvals too, tagging @matt @nina.
matt: I can do a quick review now. Noting the integration flake in CI: `test_kv_cache_eviction` failing intermittently.
build-bot: CI queue snapshot: 82 pending jobs, median start ETA ~45m. https://ci.redwood.example/queue (reported at 5478901250)
nina: I'm out for a few hours, back at 15:30 PST. If it's blocking, @sam can help approve.
sam: I can take it if the failing test isn't related to the schema change. Can someone paste the failing log?
carla: Paste of the relevant tail: ```RuntimeError: cuBLAS launch failed at attention.cpp:342
2026-03-18 10:02:11 ERROR: GPU runner segfault during long-seq test``` Looks like a GPU runtime flake, not the schema. Rebase might not help but worth trying after infra priorities.
liam: Given the 18:00 deploy freeze, I agree we should prefer the 16:00 canary window. Trying to push it now risks being stuck in queue until post-freeze.
matt: Rebase + `ci/rerun` could clear stale caches but queue is the real bottleneck. @eng-infra any chance to spin a small canary lane?
eng-infra-bot: INF ticket created: INF-879 — provision 1 small-gpu canary node for short-run CI. ETA ~20m. I'll post back when ready.
carla: Awesome, thanks. I'll mark the PR with label `hold-for-canary` and update the description with the plan: wait INF-879 -> rebase -> rerun CI -> merge in canary. If infra can't deliver, fallback to a rolling deploy after freeze.
sam: I'll start review now and leave approval pending a green CI run.
nina: I left one minor comment about the test harness; otherwise looks good. Can approve when green.
matt: I pushed one tiny change to reduce flakiness in test setup (no functional change).
build-bot: CI rerun scheduled by @carla at 5478902800 on small-gpu-lane (subject to INF-879 provisioning).
carla: Plan is set. Will unhold and merge once the rerun passes and at least two approvals are present. Marking thread resolved after merge. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
